definitions.explanation: The central part of the body excluding the head and limbs; in fitness, the deep muscles of the torso that support posture and movement.

examples.japanese: {体幹|たいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{体幹|たいかん}⟦トレーニング→トレーニング：00408_toreeningu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to do core training every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{体幹|たいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しっかりしている→しっかりする：21456_shikkarisuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{当|あ}たり{負|ま}け⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Professional athletes have strong cores, so they don't get knocked off balance by contact.

notes:
USAGE:
{体幹|たいかん} has become a widely used fitness term in Japan. It refers to the trunk muscles (abdominals, back, pelvis, diaphragm) that stabilize the body. The term gained popularity through sports science and fitness media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体幹|たいかん}⟦トレーニング→トレーニング：00408_toreeningu⟧ (core training)
- {体幹|たいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧ (to train/strengthen the core)
- {体幹|たいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (to have a strong core)
- {体幹|たいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧ (to have a weak core)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦インナー→インナー：24423_innaa⟧マッスル (inner muscles — often used interchangeably in casual speech)
- ⟦{腹筋|ふっきん}→腹筋：15891_fukkin⟧ (abdominal muscles — one component of the core)
